field_reviews.explanation: The paper places this route in the evaluation split: "The model reads the top-200 ranked genes of a cell and generates its cell type as free text... Evaluation set: n =5 , 000 held-out cells from hca_test."
The split rule is explicit: "Cells with h ≤ 7 go to train, h =8 to validation, and h =9 to test."
Table 1 explicitly lists the test split as "hca_test".

The methods state the full preprocessing chain for HCA cells: "After quality control (min. 500 genes per cell, < 20% mitochondrial reads), log-normalisation to library size 10 4 , and conversion to ranked Cell Sentences of topK =200 HGNC gene symbols, we apply a deterministic hash-based partition."
The visible carrier is explicitly "ranked Cell Sentences of topK =200 HGNC gene symbols".
This is a text-native serialized biological profile, not a dense embedding or image carrier.
The paper explicitly says the cells are converted into ranked Cell Sentences before model use.
The document supports text serialization and prepending of virtual tokens elsewhere, but it does not establish a route-level topology named "tokenizer_sequence" for this HCA split route.
The ranked Cell Sentence is the actual textual input used for evaluation.
The route is an evaluation input set: "Evaluation set: n =5 , 000 held-out cells from hca_test."
